name: REQUIEM -Aquamarines-
source: By coincidence, Bill lost his memory, Sharp holds on to a heroic desire, their personalities are completely different, but they are attracted to each other by 2 boys. He encounters a miracle on an isolated island in the sea. The boy did not know, but this strange "Bloody Island" has unique and cruel rules. A game of survival to the last man is played out. A fierce battle is played out because of the boys who are trapped in the sea by one tragedy after another. I wonder if there is some unknown danger waiting for the two people who are attracted to each other......
translation: 机缘巧合之下，比尔失去了记忆，夏普则怀揣着英雄的愿望，两人性格截然不同，却被两个男孩所吸引。他在海上的一座孤岛上遇到了奇迹。男孩并不知道，这个陌生的“血腥岛”有着独特而残酷的规则。一场生存到最后一人的游戏即将上演。男孩们因一次又一次的悲剧被困在海里，展开了一场激烈的战斗。不知道是不是有什么未知的危险在等待着互相吸引的两个人……
